_comment: SIGNAL 45 slice utility families (four, D-043): capacity/demand/priority/condition — never currencies. PROVISIONAL values; loaded by survival_model.py.

power.tier_note: the slice ships no optional-tier loads; the lowest occupied tier is Normal (hotplate/tools) — shedding walks tiers lowest-first (D-045)

battery.bridge: keeps critical tier alive 1 phase after producer failure
battery.bridge_note: 5 cell-hours ≈ one phase of critical+essential load (20/day ÷ 4 phases); the full battery covers ~3 phases at critical-only draw
battery.bridge_side_effect: normal tier shed while bridging (cold meal that evening)

overload.effect: sheds the lowest occupied tier first (Normal in the slice), load by load, with banner; residual deficit draws the battery/cell rack; never silently

air.rule: air degrades over phases, never instantly; per-section quality (core / east / west); doors and the Level-1 seal isolate sections; exposure without protection = respiratory_exposure condition

water_network.warning_rule: every water warning names the failing link
water_network.east_chain: emergency tank (source+storage) + transfer pump + purifier cartridge
water_network.west_chain: cistern main (source) + Pump Room (pumping) + Cistern Works (purification+storage)

structure.rule: structural state is per bay/section, never one global bar; propagation only to adjacent unreinforced bays; reinforcement halts propagation

cross_effects: power loss stops scrubbers (battery bridges critical 1 phase)
storm intake clog spikes scrubber draw, consuming power headroom (air demand -> power)
power loss past the essential tier stalls pumps (power -> water pumping)
flooding (unpumped west) threatens the west trunk node if drained-then-neglected
unstable structure blocks access to the section's utility node
water shortage halves cleaning effectiveness (sanitation derives from water + cleaning + crowding in the slice)
overloaded air raises respiratory risk for occupants of the affected section

overlays.rule: one overlay active at a time: Power / Air / Water / Structure; the persistent engineer's-overlay toggle opens pre-selected to the worst-warning-state family, with an in-overlay four-family selector (contextual UI — the 09 A.9 persistent-chrome list is unchanged); each overlay shows source, connected areas, capacity vs demand, warning, unconnected rooms, time-to-failure, and the most useful response; room panel answers requires/receives/why-impaired/what-restores/what-if-ignored in plain language first
overlays.badge_rule: warning-state badges for ALL families stay anchored at overview regardless of which overlay (if any) is open — the redundant shape-coded channel never depends on correct family selection (07 §19)
overlays.build_lens_rule: the build lens force-enables the cross-family node-capacity summary (per-node capacity vs demand for every family), riding whichever overlay is active
overlays.plain_language_rule: AIR FILTRATION - SCRUBBER GATE, never raw telemetry; advanced numbers behind an optional inspect layer

cascade_bounds.bound_note: the bound counts SYSTEMS TOUCHED, not chain links — the four-link storm chain touches 3 systems (air, power, water)
